kept_items.text: Microsoft has identified a supply chain attack on the Mastra-AI npm ecosystem, with 80+ packages compromised through npm account takeover. The attacker introduced a phantom dependency into the compromised packages.

kept_items.text: The British Government has published 'AI Scenarios 2030: Helping policymakers plan for the future of AI'. Written by Government Office for Science (GO-Science) with input from AISI and DSIT and external experts, it examines five scenarios.
kept_items.selection_reason: Concrete UK government policy publication with named authoring bodies.

kept_items.author: Sam_Badawi
kept_items.text: $AMZN is backing Archetype AI, a startup building AI models that understand and interact with the physical world using real-world sensor data. The investment is part of Amazon's broader push into 'Physical AI'.
kept_items.selection_reason: Concrete Amazon investment + Physical AI strategy; distinct company news.

kept_items.author: Sam_Badawi
kept_items.text: Yesterday $IREN completed its acquisition of Nostrum Group, marking its expansion into Europe with approximately 490MW of secured, grid-connected power capacity in Spain. The deal strengthens IREN's AI cloud infrastructure platform.
kept_items.selection_reason: AI-infrastructure M&A with concrete capacity figure; distinct from model news.

kept_items.text: Anthropic's new Mythos model has sparked significant concern regarding its fearsome AI power and the potential risks it poses to global security. John Reed explains what you need to know about the cutting-edge AI tool.

kept_items.author: dharmesh
kept_items.text: Do not infer with AI that which can be queried without. That's from an internal presentation I gave at HubSpot today. LLMs are great, but there are a lot of use cases that are much better handled with a structured query (like SQL).
kept_items.selection_reason: Named practitioner (HubSpot CTO) concrete engineering principle; useful analysis.
